name: refine-matk
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Weapon refining also raises MATK, so magic classes get something out of a blacksmith too. Bonus scales with the weapon's own tier. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: MATK per refine, Lv1 weapons
settings.description: Daggers and other Level 1 weapons. Applied per +1 refine on the main-hand.

settings.label: MATK per refine, Lv2 weapons
settings.description: One-handed swords, axes, maces and the rest of Level 2. Applied per +1 refine on the main-hand.

settings.label: MATK per refine, Lv3 weapons
settings.description: Two-handed swords, spears, staves and other Level 3 weapons. Applied per +1 refine on the main-hand.

settings.label: MATK per refine, Lv4 weapons
settings.description: Bows and top-tier Level 4 weapons. Applied per +1 refine on the main-hand.
